Preserve the new ActiveAssembly pressure diagnostic as observation only until H1 traces adjudicate policy.

No syntax expansion is forced. H2 should be able to reproduce pressure telemetry and shared trace identity without letting telemetry alter selection or authority. Cross-language canonicalization remains a separate requirement.

Add conflict_slot_fraction/pressure_band to matched ActiveAssembly policy experiments and integrate the diagnostic into Golden Trace observability. Target-Ubuntu ledger differential remains P0 before consumers freeze incompatible state identities.
Conflict visibility and evidence independence remain separate graph semantics. Grouped conflict/re-expansion is now a concrete OPEN experiment family, not a truth mutation.

Persist enough conflict-group, selection-policy, epoch and trace identity to replay alternative ActiveAssembly policies against the same underlying semantic state. Physical database consolidation remains evidence-dependent.

WorkspaceEpisode stage receipts should bind to the same integrated trace basis as ActiveAssembly/ledger. EVENT_BUS remains mandatory null; ActiveAssembly policy must be controlled because it changes downstream causal exposure.
Set-valued alternatives suggest grouped conflict representation plus selective re-expansion as a candidate way to reduce context pressure; provenance/detail-loss falsifiers are mandatory.

Selection policy is an intervention/confound. Emergence/GWT comparisons must hold ActiveAssembly policy fixed or factorially vary it; pressure telemetry becomes an intervention covariate, never an emergence score.
